caption: The drawing depicts a square textile pattern composed of geometric designs in blue, reddish-brown, and beige. The central area of the textile shows a beige background with four vertical, irregular navy blue motifs arranged in a row. Surrounding the central section are borders that feature alternating blocks of blue and reddish-brown checkerboard and grid patterns on the top and bottom edges. In between these checkerboard sections at the top and bottom, there are smaller vertical bands with a beige background intersected by thin blue and reddish-brown lines, creating a grid-like effect. The entire composition is symmetrical, and the background of the drawing is off-white, with handwritten text in the lower right and lower left corners.
title: Coverlet Detail
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
